extracted.intended_audience: grant writers, nonprofit staff, community advocates, and researchers who need to use ACS data in grant applications
extracted.subtask_short: using ACS data for grant writing
extracted.subtask_description: Instruction on how to locate and apply American Community Survey (ACS) data to answer questions in grant applications and to support community advocacy, including live demonstration of data.census.gov and best practices for searching. Focused on practical use of ACS estimates for preparing grant narratives, needs statements, and supporting evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ACS data to answer questions in grant applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about how data from the American Community Survey (ACS) can answer a variety of questions posed in grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame grant application needs and questions so they map to available ACS variables and tables; use ACS estimates to quantify needs, populations served, and local conditions relevant to proposals. (Webinar context: July 24, 2025 presentation by U.S. Census Bureau.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ACS data to support community advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Use ACS data to provide information needed to advocate for the members of your local communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select geographic levels and variables that reflect the communities of interest; present ACS findings to stakeholders and funders to justify programs or policy proposals. The webinar emphasizes practical examples for advocacy use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow best practices for searching ACS data on data.census.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: You'll also learn best practices to search for ACS data you need for grant applications through a live demonstration of data.census.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance includes live demonstration techniques for locating appropriate tables and variables on data.census.gov, tips for selecting the correct estimate type (e.g., 1-year vs 5-year), and how to access supporting documentation and related learning materials at https://www.census.gov/data/academy/webinars/2025/acs-for-grant-writing.html.
